name: Scoundrel
description: The scoundrel is a ruffian known for their lack of honor and penchant for criminal activities. These types of creatures can be found in all walks of society praying on the weak and lurking in the shadows waiting for their next target.

actions.name: Improvise
actions.description: The scoundrel makes a quick, unorthodox attack against a dazed or stunned creature, dealing damage.

actions.name: Weapon Strike
actions.description: The scoundrel makes an attack with a light melee weapon, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Slip
actions.description: In response to being the target of a melee attack, the scoundrel gains a 1d4 bonus to their defensive check. If they successfully avoid the attack, they can then move 2 units without provoking reactions.

actions.name: Hidden Dagger
actions.description: The scoundrel unsheathes and throws a hidden dagger at a target within 4 units, dealing physical damage. If the defender botches their check, this attack deals an extra 1d6 damage. Once this attack has been used, it cannot be used again within the same initiative.

actions.name: Cheap Shot
actions.description: The scoundrel makes a melee attack against a creature dealing no damage, but causing the dazed condition on a hit until the end of the target's next turn. On a true hit, the target is stunned instead.

traits.name: Ready to Fight
traits.description: On the first round of initiative, the scoundrel deals an extra 1d6 damage on their first attack against creatures lower on the initiative order than them.
